reviews.text: Great dog treats and I even found a Spurs folding fan for my cousin.

Pawsitively Sweet Bakery has been our go to for the past 5 years for every one of my sweet pups birthdays! My fur babies love their cakes and treats! Their cakes are always beautifully crafted and look so delicious. 😍 My pups always get so excited when their birthday comes around and when they get to eat their treats (that come in all sorts of tasty sounding flavors!). Thank you PAWsitively for always making my pups birthday special! Here are some photos of their latest b-days!  🐶🐾😍

Incredibly professional. In light of recent and sudden closing of The Painted Tree, the owners have worked endlessly to find solutions to providing their customers with their orders despite no longer having a store front. The cakes are beautiful and delicious. I cant speak highly enough about the work these ladies do.

So apparently there are no longer in there store location, so not sure where cakes are being made. There has no update to there website to let customers know. So I ordered a cake and it was supposed to be picked up at another location but it was dropped somehow. They have no staff available to replace it and a lot of excuses. Now refund will take weeks
Thanks friends :) Give you pup our love 🐾 …
Answered all my questions patiently, and again thank you for accommodating our beautiful pups of San Antonio!!!
If you like being ignored because you asked for a refund, this is place to go! The unprofessionalism of this business is insane.

Ordered a gender reveal cake for my brother and sister n laws reveal. A few things: the cake was a lot smaller than I thought but I honestly didn’t check to see if any measurements were listed on the pic, if your dog isn’t used to treats they will take forever to eat this, but if they are I’m sure they will gobble it up! Lastly, the customer service was great! I called and had a few questions that were answered without hesitation! The cake was ready for pick up at the exact time they provided.  I would buy from here again and definitely recommend.
Absolutely love love the cakes here my Frankie will be turning 4 and this will be his fourth most favorite bday cake ever😋 The staff is very friendly and welcoming …
